status: Partial human reconstruction of RH and unrestricted Dirichlet GRH, accepting the pinned formal proof as correct. Version 0.55 continues the detailed proof-note approach with 87 independently reviewed numbered claims, bringing the inventory to 3538. It completes both original Serre very-ample conclusions, the actual local arithmetic objects/flat representation charts, the exact conditional stabilizer-volume theorem and actual volume join, and the full inhomogeneous invariant Frobenius-matrix descent. No additional whole selected obligation is closed: 24 remain, comprising 17 class C and 7 class B, with 17 shared RH/GRH and 7 additional unrestricted Dirichlet-GRH obligations. Polarization/multiplication/rank/square inputs, component dimensions/seeds/propagation and automorphic producers, the actual Wach prism and later comparison, and RealBracket/finite-place/transport/counting/spectral producers remain. GLOBAL_LOCAL_GAIN remains fully closed from v0.49. Counts are inventories, not completion percentages. No Lean replay or PDF is claimed.
local_conclusions: SHV1–SHV21 complete both original Serre very-ample conclusions. One finite homogeneous module models the actual nonempty section-cube vertices before the degree is chosen. Laurent monomials give a concrete positive-degree free contraction; finitely many Noetherian syzygies give one large-degree bound. Explicit affine cocycles, two denominator/torsion exponents, refinement descent and the ordered sign return this to all original covers. The same augmented-complex argument proves the saturated-span theorem and expresses every high-power section by one homogeneous polynomial in the original sections. GSL_SERRE is supplied; multiplication/invariant descent, polarization, rank and square suppliers remain.

ALC1–ALC22 complete the actual arithmetic local objects and charts in ranks two and three. Universal maps identify every finite quotient, hence the original completion. The Artin-Rees argument proves finite-module completion exactness, flatness and prime/minimal-prime return on the given algebra map. Marked-coordinate projectors and entry-ideal comparisons prove the original residual types and LocRho. A monic unramified coefficient construction and residue-compatible completion give full loc_ex at every original closed point over m_B. The resulting component charts are ready for propagation; sharp dimensions, seed incidence, rank-three corner, full propagation, OffFin and automorphic producers remain.

SVW1–SVW18 complete the original stabilizer-volume theorem from its exact smooth Siegel-Weil premises. Every supplied Gram-fiber measure is identified using admissible determining tests. Rational orbit unfolding is proved with extended nonnegative integrals before finite stabilizer mass is known. One explicit smooth positive test gives a nonzero theta integral, forces finite mass, and permits legitimate scalar cancellation. All original character, measure, fiber and domain witnesses remain. The generic InVolumesAt and actual three volume fields on the GMR19 output follow, using its existing unipotent normalization. RealBracket, retained Siegel-Weil density, finite factors and later counting/spectral fields remain.

IFD1–IFD26 complete the full original invariant inhomogeneous Frobenius-matrix descent. Exact sharp-root equivariance puts invariant coordinates in the already identified completed fixed field; original cyclotomic and prime-to-p generators then approximate every invariant tilt coordinate. The actual near-filtration has a closed coefficient image modulo p. A shifted filtration makes the finite matrix Frobenius operator contract, and prime-adic lifting makes Phi-1 bijective on the quotient. Vectorization gives the full rectangular inhomogeneous endpoint. IFD26 now leaves the actual prism as the one period-ring supplier before conditional WachEx, retaining original tied data, realization and later comparison inputs.
remaining_major_inputs: SVW supplies full original VolStabFromSWS under exactly SWa1 and StabilizerFirstChernCompatibility, including every IsOmT, self-dual/fiber, character, Haar and fundamental-domain witness. It proves finite theta sums, actual rational Witt orbit transitivity, Borel stabilizer domains, both unimodularities, fixed-parameter density identification, nonnegative unfolding before finiteness, one common positive admissible smooth test, and finite stabilizer mass before scalar cancellation. It supplies the literal generic InVolumesAt and the actual bOf.InVolumes return on the GMR19 rescaled setting. That setting already contains both unipotent covolume-one equations; no new normalization is required for this join. AOS exact archimedean scalar and all-section integration remain available on the same bridge and infinity measures. The distinct RealBracket still needs reference unipotent covolume/discriminant calculation, broad JacGauge/PlaceSplit and ProdExact at every supplied factorization and section. The original Siegel-Weil arithmetic density premise itself, finite-place factors and remaining mass/index/column/form/counting fields are not proved by the conditional volume comparison. BQS full BesselNVGap is available; Forms0, all-family Witt/genus/level/intertwiner Transport/LevelMatch, Bessel uniqueness, AutTie/RowDictTie/LabTie, simultaneous arithmetic cylinder counts and the normalized GLOBAL_SPECTRAL estimate remain.

SHV supplies both original Serre conjuncts: all-cover first-cohomology vanishing for every sufficiently high integer twist of an arbitrary line bundle on the original Noetherian very-ample scheme, and an actual homogeneous polynomial expression for every sufficiently high power-section. One finite homogeneous module and a finite syzygy list are fixed before the degree. Affine all-cover vanishing, two principal-cover exponents, refinement descent and the exact ordered sign return the chosen-cover calculation to the literal FirstCohomologyVanishes predicate. The original GSL_SERRE input is now supplied; do not reopen it, the high-power polynomial theorem, or the ASL full arbitrary-base smooth-projective Perf producer. Remaining for GSL17 are PolBaseChangeSt, multiplication-pullback generated comparison, finite/flat/surjective and etale multiplication geometry, and invariant-function descent on every relevant open. Geometric integrality, principal rank one, torsion-indexed section decomposition, two-sided growth, and square/translation generators remain for the full P,V,R,T and GSL26/NFL joins. Original Moduli and HUF/PUN foundations remain. Later finite-level systems, Gaussian/reproduction, simultaneous dictionaries, ramified jets, all-tuple class sums, phase-sensitive uniqueness, common PointIdentCore and base ClassSumsSpan remain, retaining both levels, whole fields, Fits and eta agreement.

ALC supplies full original cpl_of_univ, loc_cpl, c3a, completion construction/uniqueness, LocFlat, idem, types, LocRho, unramified coefficient extension and loc_ex. Every original closed point over the coefficient maximal ideal now has an actual local object with the required completion, prime contraction, flatness, representation and component-chart fields in both ranks two and three. The finite quotients are identified by the original universal property; Artin-Rees and inverse limits prove completion flatness on the original algebra map. Rank-three projectors are explicit polynomials in the marked diagonal and do not borrow the rank-two triangular argument. The local coefficient extension is constructed from a monic lift of a finite residue-field polynomial. All RTC upstream wpres/co_B/gr_A/cont_u, preconnected_rank_two and FinPtDown are completed inputs; no FinA conclusion is used upstream. Remaining are sharp component chains, dimension bounds, nice-prime properties, global density and seed incidence, complete rank-two propagation, the rank-two-to-three corner and exceptional ideal, rank-three propagation and OffFin. Existence of the originally supplied universal spaces, actual automorphic seeds, patching/modularity, classicality and stronger Alt WitA/WitAQ outputs remain separate. Preserve the common AFE marked frame, original arithmetic P where used, rank-specific rings and ideals, all coefficient maps and the Host ell=3 case; do not identify the two ranks local coefficient extensions without a proved comparison.

IFD supplies the full original inhomogeneous cyclotomic-kernel-fixed Frobenius matrix descent, not only the homogeneous case required by WLD26. It proves full generic const_dvd/near_closed, exact actual invariant tilt approximation, eventual Frobenius approximation, and full abstract additive and matrix quotient bijectivity. Exact fixed sharp-root coordinates and LS1 completed fixed fields avoid an unnecessary cyclotomic Tate cohomology detour; the original coefficient field, action, parameter, finite basis and p=2 case are preserved. WIS inclusion, saturation and both completeness structures are completed inputs. Exactly one period-ring supplier remains before conditional full WachEx: the actual Wach prism with all prescribed maps, scalar identity and both coefficient decompositions. IFD26/WLD26 retains original LocTied/IsStd and Bhatt-Scholze crystalline realization. Full all-layer WachEx is not yet unconditional. Separate FaithH, EtBasis, Herr class maps and quantitative comparison remain for HW/Fon/Cmp; no extra outer-layer transition system is introduced. Then every original local row/table bound must hold in one common ConclF family, retaining ShaFinOdd, exceptional sets, vvTerm summability and uniform thresholds. SSC, DFD12 and DNE remain available, with DNE K=2000(|Ca|+1)^3 fixed before the family. Whole GLOBAL_DENOMINATOR remains open.

Complete the original F3 local coefficient bridges and F4 common-overfield readings, with valuation/norm/GoodCoef/iq and the entire coefficient field, and actual complex Hecke standard/no-Jordan plus arithmetic character data on the same form datum. Construct the actual base rows, host/frame lengths, nonzero chains and group ties, MultEq support, eigensystem/carrier/parts, all-embedding logLam, HD/d3b and NEb. Keep the stronger second DivRows3 scope distinct from the completed first DivDef3 and row-pair integrability. The full arithmetic entry and conditional common-frame construction do not by themselves install HOST_NUMBER_S, HOST_FRAME_LENGTH, TASK_HOST_VAN_E_INSTALL, TASK_HOST_XPP_INSTALL or TASK_COUNT_V_INSTALL.

Continue the distinct retained-defect, period-height and normalized spectral producers, and the original compatible second-layer selection on one common arithmetic/geometric family. Common design existence, NBUILT compatibility, original true-column records, shared fields/embeddings, Fits and eta agreement, simultaneous rows and eventual-family thresholds remain explicit.
